name: Pendle Ecosystem USDC
oneLiner: pendleUSDC is a Pendle and Armitage co-curated USDC vault on Ethereum; shares accrue lending interest, bear losses and redeem subject to liquidity.
collateral: USDC lender positions in three Morpho markets secured by PT-reUSD-10DEC2026, PT-sUSDS-26NOV2026 and PT-sUSDE-26NOV2026
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares accrue lending interest and realize losses against USDC. Ordinary redemption burns shares for idle USDC and liquidity from the configured liquidity adapter. Force-deallocation can access other liquid markets; an in-kind exit instead retains underlying lending-position exposure. Vault V2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero and do not measure available liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum vault 0x55c1b6e461a6334b567baf0feb5d728715446f05 issues ERC-4626 shares representing USDC-denominated Morpho lender positions. Shares absorb lending losses and accrue interest; ordinary redemption depends on idle USDC and selected adapter-market liquidity, which differs from the fiat-cash parent. At Ethereum block 26197390 (hash 0x7b440503cf5ab984190e71b6363dc024da6e6944ed5cf22073f6eca2a26092de; timestamp 2026-10-15T10:43:11Z), totalSupply=54428789336656703110422943 atomic shares and accrueInterestView assets=55037908277824 atomic USDC, pending performance shares=1632717121445232583 and management shares=0. Idle USDC=0; the complete one-adapter, three-market inventory sums exactly to totalAssets. Share decimals=18, asset decimals=6 and convertToAssets(1e18)=1011191. This establishes protocol-position claim identity and accounting, not a fixed-dollar obligation, full-liquidity guarantee or financial attestation.

notices.title: Curator terms restrict UK and US access
notices.message: Armitage's terms prohibit UK and US persons from accessing or using its covered vaults, including through third-party interfaces. Direct contract permissions do not override those terms; withdrawals remain subject to market liquidity.
